translated_title: Mexico Reduces Its Illiteracy Rate to 3.8%: Public Education Secretariat
original_title: México reduce a 3.8% su tasa de analfabetismo: SEP
author: Fernanda Monroy
meta_description: In the first year of a national adult-literacy drive, 277,000 people learned to read and write, and the INEA has now reached 32.4 million Mexicans in 45 years.
